title: Shadowrealm Jail and Crime Guide: Stables, Heists, Breakouts
subtitle: How sentences, the Black Stables and jailbreaks work, and when the risk is worth it.
description: How the Shadowrealm jail and crime system works: failed crimes, sentences, breakouts and the Black Stables odds, and when the risk is worth taking.
card: How crime, jail, the Black Stables and jailbreaks work in Shadowrealm: Age of Darkness, with the real odds and sentence lengths.

faq.q: What happens when I go to jail in Shadowrealm?
faq.a: Jail is a timed lockout. You either wait out the sentence or another player breaks you free. You can also try breaking out prisoners yourself from the Most Wanted list, which earns rewards and builds a separate jailbreak rank.

faq.q: Can a new character be jailed?
faq.a: Not at first. A character's first 30 actions can never send them to jail, however the roll lands. After that, a failed crime can result in a sentence, so check the odds before committing.

faq.q: Are the Black Stables worth it?
faq.a: They pay far more than honest crime but jail you more often. In our screenshot the four grounds range from about 84 percent odds and 40 percent jail risk up to about 62 percent and 70 percent, so pick the ground that matches your stats.
